text:
I’m running to put people, communities, and the future back at the center of public life. Follow the work, shape the priorities, and help turn this campaign into action.

Hart 2028 is becoming more direct, personal, and accountable. I’ll share regular videos from the road, what people are telling me, and how those conversations are changing the work.

Understand the candidate, follow the campaign, explore the issues, or take action. The next step should always be clear.

Start with the priorities people are already discussing, voting on, and asking the campaign to address.

Hart 2028 supports equal rights, equal opportunity, reproductive freedom, and full dignity for women in every part of American life. We believe women should have the power to make their own healthcare decisions, earn equal pay, live free from violence, and participate fully.

Support our veterans and military families with Hart 2028. Together, we can ensure they receive the care, respect, and opportunities they deserve.

Empowering rural communities means ensuring access to healthcare, education, and jobs. Hart 2028 is committed to revitalizing these essential areas for a brighter future.

Hart 2028 supports a government that is honest, accountable, transparent, and focused on people instead of special interests.

Join Hart 2028 in the fight for civil rights. Together, we can create a future where everyone is treated with dignity, justice, and equality.

Hart 2028 supports a fair, secure, and humane immigration system that protects the border, respects the law, strengthens communities, and gives hardworking families a real path to stability.

Every volunteer, event, conversation, and contribution helps move Hart 2028 beyond views and into participation.

Help with outreach, calls, events, digital work, supporter follow-up, and local organizing.

Join a public conversation, meet the campaign, or help bring Hart to your community.

Fund road travel, daily video, organizing, events, and the tools needed to reach more people.

Focused topic pages connect broad priorities to specific questions people are facing now.

Access to quality healthcare is a women's right. Stand with Hart 2028 to ensure health equity for all women across America.

Let’s honor our veterans not just with words, but with meaningful action that reflects our gratitude and respect for their sacrifices.

Community strength is built on connection and support. With Hart 2028, we can uplift rural America by fostering unity and collaboration.

Every voter deserves to be heard without barriers. Hart 2028 stands firm against intimidation and confusion in elections, ensuring a truly participative democracy.

Stand with Hart 2028 to celebrate diversity and promote inclusivity in every aspect of our society.

Upcoming gatherings, livestreams, and public conversations will be posted as they are announced.

Support the road work, direct communication, public events, and organizing needed to turn growing attention into a real campaign.

Follow Hart Cunningham, explore the campaign’s priorities, and help turn growing support into meaningful action.
